system.description: Created by Victor's mentor to keep an unseen eye on other Vampires, this ritual summons a small rat to the caster, who can send it to a specified location to watch for something specific. Feeding the rat minute amounts of alcohol and casting the ritual takes about twenty minutes. On its return, the rat presses its head to the caster to "show" her everything it witnessed. The rat can also be instructed to steal small, precisely described items. It remains in service until sunrise, and can still be affected normally by Animalism.
system.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred (created by Victor's mentor)
